Validated Diagram Generation
|-- [M] Boundaries: orchestration -> generation contract -> domain revisions -> canvas port
|   |-- DiagramEditService: start / get / wait / cancel / dispose
|   |   |-- Coordinates edit, variant, create and extend requests
|   |   |-- Keeps run records, request signatures and installation helpers private
|   |   `-- Depends on DiagramGenerator, DiagramEditCanvasPort and optional context store
|   |-- DiagramBatchService: stages operations through child DiagramEditService instances
|   |   `-- Requires an additional canvas.batch application boundary
|   |-- DiagramGenerator.generate(request, options)
|   |   |-- Input: captured diagram, instruction, prompt, scope and logical node identities
|   |   |-- Output: candidate ASCII, structure, optional mappings and node correspondence
|   |   |-- Options: cancellation signal and progress/session/context callbacks
|   |   `-- Implementations: PiDiagramEditRuntime or FakeDiagramEditRuntime
|   |-- Domain boundary
|   |   |-- validateGeneratedDiagramEdit: checks candidates without issuing revisions
|   |   `-- submitStoredDiagramEdit: domain submission and revision issuance
|   `-- Canvas boundary
|       |-- snapshot: document state plus requested retained revisions
|       |-- apply: install revision or variants with expected document/base versions
|       |-- create: optional, request-idempotent placement of new diagrams
|       `-- batch: acknowledge the combined staged application
|-- [C] Request execution
|   |-- Single request: DiagramEditService.start
|   |   |-- Validate operation options, context source/session and prompt template
|   |   |-- Look up (sessionId, requestId)
|   |   |   |-- Different signature -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|   |   |   |-- Same signature -> return existing run
|   |   |   `-- Awaiting acknowledgement and idle -> retry installation only
|   |   `-- New run -> launch generate
|   |       |-- Read pinned inputs and check expected canvas/base versions
|   |       |   `-- Variant refinement: load retained review revisions and saved scope
|   |       |-- Produce candidate revision
|   |       |   |-- Supplied submission -> submitStoredDiagramEdit directly
|   |       |   `-- Generated submission -> generateDiagram
|   |       |       |-- Verify base belongs to requested diagram; check cancellation
|   |       |       |-- Call generator with cloned request and authoritative nodeRefs
|   |       |       |   `-- PiDiagramEditRuntime.generate
|   |       |       |       |-- Render template; resolve context sources; create session
|   |       |       |       |-- session.prompt -> agent calls submit_diagram_edit
|   |       |       |       |   `-- createValidatedSubmission.execute(candidate)
|   |       |       |       |       |-- Validate schema, content, continuity and mappings
|   |       |       |       |       |-- Scoped edit: preserve structure kind and check replacements
|   |       |       |       |       |-- Rejected -> report issues; request correction; do not terminate
|   |       |       |       |       `-- Accepted -> retain candidate; return terminate: true
|   |       |       |       |-- Prompt finishes without accepted value -> fail
|   |       |       |       `-- Revalidate accepted value; capture context if requested; return
|   |       |       `-- Check cancellation -> submitStoredDiagramEdit -> issued revision
|   |       `-- Install produced result
|   |           |-- In-place edit -> canvas.apply(revision)
|   |           |-- Variant edit -> build and validate review records -> canvas.apply(variants)
|   |           |   `-- Optional presentation alternatives reference generated revisions/scopes
|   |           `-- Create / extend -> canvas.create(diagrams)
|   |               |-- Create count: generate sequentially; extend: generate one diagram
|   |               |-- Read latest canvas; compute placement; recheck extension anchors
|   |               `-- Placement VERSION_CONFLICT -> retry, at most 3 attempts
|   |-- Batch request: DiagramBatchService.start
|   |   |-- Parse direct or generation batch; deduplicate by request signature
|   |   |-- Capture one shared snapshot and verify expected version
|   |   |-- Reject multiple edits targeting the same logical diagram
|   |   |-- For each operation, sequentially
|   |   |   |-- Create child edit service using a staging canvas port
|   |   |   |-- Child snapshots reuse shared state; extra revision reads must match its version
|   |   |   |-- Child apply/create append to staged edits/creations
|   |   |   `-- Wait for child success before starting the next operation
|   |   `-- All children succeed -> canvas.batch once for the combined application
|   |       |-- Receipt supplies final document version and unresolved edge IDs
|   |       `-- Failure/cancellation before this call leaves staged canvas changes unapplied
|   `-- Application outcome, single or batch
|       |-- Acknowledged -> completed
|       |-- VERSION_CONFLICT -> conflict
|       |-- Applying + timeout / unavailable / persistence pending -> awaiting-acknowledgement
|       |   `-- Same request retried -> reuse retained result/application; no model rerun
|       `-- Other error -> failed
|-- [O] State, cancellation and cleanup
|   |-- Edit service owns each request's generation and installation state
|   |   |-- Retains input clone, signature, AbortController, pending work and generated results
|   |   |-- get/start expose cloned run state
|   |   |-- cancel while generating -> abort signal and cancelled status
|   |   |-- Once applying, cancellation does not claim an unknown outcome was cancelled
|   |   `-- dispose requests cancellation; run registries have a 500-run capacity
|   |-- Batch service retains staged application and current child
|   |   |-- Cancellation while generating propagates to active child
|   |   `-- Retained application supports acknowledgement retry
|   |-- Runtime owns agent-session resources
|   |   |-- Subscription reports progress; abort listener requests session.abort
|   |   `-- Prompt-processing finally block
|   |       `-- Remove abort listener -> unsubscribe -> dispose session -> remove from session set
|   |-- Validated-submission closure retains the accepted candidate
|   |   `-- Rejected candidates do not replace the accepted value
|   |-- Conversation history
|   |   |-- Runtime captures messages after successful submission validation
|   |   |-- Edit service retains next context after checking its source session
|   |   `-- Exposes that context on successful canvas application
|   `-- Issued revision and installed canvas state have separate lifetimes
|       `-- Generation can issue a revision before canvas installation succeeds
`-- [D] What an accepted, installed result needs
    |-- Generation request [shared request]
    |   |-- User instruction + validated template/options
    |   |-- Pinned base revision -> diagram content + authoritative logical nodeRefs
    |   |-- Replacement targets or saved variant scope -> editable ranges
    |   |-- Prompt references -> exact requested revision text or selected-node excerpts
    |   |   `-- Resolve from canvas history first, then revision registry; verify identity/ranges/nodes
    |   |-- Captured canvas connections
    |   `-- Optional agent context
    |       |-- Explicit supplied context, or bound diagram context with matching source fingerprint
    |       `-- Resolved context sources -> session input
    |-- Valid candidate
    |   |-- Candidate ASCII + structure kind + [shared request] base/nodeRefs
    |   |   `-- Strip continuity annotations -> build content -> verify unique output nodes
    |   |-- Source-mapping flag + mappings
    |   |   |-- Disabled -> nonempty mappings rejected
    |   |   `-- Enabled -> mappings array required; empty array allowed
    |   `-- Base source context + rebuilt content/hash -> domain diagram validation
    |-- Issued revision
    |   `-- Accepted candidate + generation request -> domain submission
    `-- Installed result
        |-- Issued revision(s) or creation content + destination/scope
        |-- Expected document version; edits also carry expected base revision
        `-- Canvas acknowledgement -> final document version and completion state
